title: Valheim 1.0 compatibility refresh
changes: Updated Epic Loot, FastLink, First Person Mode, Haulers Helper, Max Player Count, Ship Stats, OdinShip, and Jotunn for local compatibility testing.
Removed Marketplace temporarily because its prerelease version could not be represented safely in the pack manifest.
Restored CustomMainMenu with its incompatible intro skip disabled so the vanilla intro remains visible.
Kept the Ragnavik UI compass and clock while retiring its inventory positioning behavior.
